requirement:
`habeas author <full-name> [--config <name>] [--missing | --force] [--stdout] [-v|--verbose]`
MUST author the evidence of one existing requirement or named example in the
current project, under {cite}`requirements.authoring.refresh`. It MUST report the
selected subject, backend, model, evidence destination, and usage-record path on
completion. The evidence destination MUST identify the evidence-file path by
default or stdout when `--stdout` is selected. In stdout mode, the completion
report and diagnostics MUST go to stderr. `author-evidence` MUST remain an alias
for the single-subject command.
rationale:
The reviewed tests cover each obligation in `requirements.authoring.invocation`. I did not read any implementation source.

- **Requirement and example subjects.** `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[initial_prompt_substitutes_subject_and_mandatory_inputs_into_the_template]` runs `author` on a requirement and on a named example. It checks that each run succeeds and writes `evidence/<subject>.json` with the matching `requirement` or `example` field. `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[author_rejects_unknown_subjects_and_conflicting_targets]` checks that an unknown subject fails and names that subject on stderr. It also checks that the evidence file is left unchanged.
- **Completion report in default mode.**
  - `fn[ollama_cli_delivers_sources_records_fixme_and_keeps_usage_content_free]` checks that stdout starts with `<SUBJECT>: ollama / <MODEL>`.
  - The same test checks that stdout has an `Evidence:` line whose path resolves to `evidence/<SUBJECT>.json`, and a `Usage:` line.
  - `fn[initial_prompt_substitutes_subject_and_mandatory_inputs_into_the_template]` repeats these checks for both subject kinds. It also checks that the usage path is an existing file.
- **`--stdout` mode.**
  - `fn[stdout_emits_only_evidence_json_without_changing_project_files]` parses stdout as pure JSON.
  - It checks that stderr carries the `subject: ollama / model` line, `Evidence: stdout`, and a `Usage:` path to an existing file.
  - No evidence file is written or changed.
  - The cases cover true, false and FIXME determinations, and the verbose and non-verbose forms.
- **Alias.** `author-evidence` is used in `fn[stdout_emits_only_evidence_json_without_changing_project_files]`, `fn[ollama_cli_delivers_sources_records_fixme_and_keeps_usage_content_free]`, `fn[author_rejects_unknown_subjects_and_conflicting_targets]`, and `fn[missing_keeps_current_records_and_force_reassesses_every_selected_subject]`.
- **`--config <name>`.** `fn[an_explicit_configuration_selects_the_nondefault_workspace_profile]` selects a non-default profile. It asserts that the request used that profile's model and key, and that the usage record shows the alternate model and backend. `fn[authoring_uses_nearest_workspace_configuration_without_a_user_file]` covers the default selection.
- **`--missing`, `--force`, and the `refresh` refinement.** `tests/authoring_batch.rs#fn[missing_keeps_current_records_and_force_reassesses_every_selected_subject]` covers the following.
  - The default and `--missing` behave the same, skip current records, and make no model call. They succeed with an unusable configuration and print the skipped-as-current report.
  - `--missing --force` and `--stdout --missing` are rejected as mutually exclusive.
  - `--force` reassesses a subject, and `--stdout` implies it.
  - An invalid evidence file is repaired under `--missing`.
- **`-v` and `--verbose`.** `fn[verbose_single_author_reports_only_false_rationale_without_source_inputs]` exercises both spellings, and the stdout test exercises `--verbose`.
- **Conflicting targets.** `--all` combined with a named subject or with `--stdout` is rejected with exit code 2.

I found no input class or failure case the text names that lacks a test with assertions.

text: :::{req} invocation
`habeas author <full-name> [--config <name>] [--missing | --force] [--stdout] [-v|--verbose]`
MUST author the evidence of one existing requirement or named example in the
current project, under {cite}`requirements.authoring.refresh`. It MUST report the
selected subject, backend, model, evidence destination, and usage-record path on
completion. The evidence destination MUST identify the evidence-file path by
default or stdout when `--stdout` is selected. In stdout mode, the completion
report and diagnostics MUST go to stderr. `author-evidence` MUST remain an alias
for the single-subject command.
:::{req} refresh
Every `habeas author` form MUST accept `--missing` and `--force`, which are
mutually exclusive; `--missing` MUST be the default. Under `--missing`, the
command MUST assess only the selected subjects whose evidence is missing, stale,
or invalid, and MUST preserve every current record without invoking a model,
including accepted FIXME judgments and current false judgments; a current false
judgment is reassessed only when its subject or inputs change or `--force` is
given. Under `--force`, the command MUST assess every selected subject. `--stdout`
MUST imply `--force`, because it writes no evidence. The command MUST report the
number of selected subjects it skipped as current. When no assessment is needed,
the command MUST succeed without resolving model configuration or credentials.
